Training.title: Training & Development
Training.subtitle: Enhancing professional capacity in cultural heritage conservation
Training.intro_title: Training Programs of the Heritage Conservation Institute
Training.intro_desc: The Heritage Conservation Institute regularly organizes professional training courses on cultural heritage conservation. Courses are designed by leading experts, combining theory with hands-on practice at actual heritage sites.
Training.course_1_desc: Techniques for diagnosing damage and restoring wooden structural elements in historical monuments.
Training.course_2_desc: Field survey methods, condition documentation, and deterioration assessment.
Training.course_3_desc: Application of 3D scanning and photogrammetry technology in heritage documentation and reconstruction.
Training.course_4_desc: Planning, construction supervision, and acceptance procedures for conservation projects.
Training.course_5_desc: Study of traditional materials: lime mortar, bricks, tiles, laterite, and construction techniques.
Training.course_6_desc: Process for building UNESCO nomination dossiers for Vietnamese heritage sites.
Training.register_desc: Fill out the form below to register for training courses. We will contact you within 3-5 working days.
Training.success_msg: We will contact you as soon as possible.

Timeline.title: History of Formation
Timeline.subtitle: Historical Chronicle of the Heritage Conservation Institute
Timeline.event_1982_desc: The predecessor of the Heritage Conservation Institute was established to meet the urgent need for maintenance and repair of architectural heritage severely deteriorated after the war.
Timeline.event_1990_title: Upgraded to Center for Heritage Design & Restoration
Timeline.event_1990_desc: Expanded functions from artifact restoration to design and consulting for large-scale restoration projects, marking a transformation in traditional wooden architecture conservation.
Timeline.event_1999_title: Establishment of Central & Southern Regional Offices
Timeline.event_1999_desc: Established branch institutes and survey networks, directly carrying out restoration of the Hue Imperial City Complex, Hoi An Ancient Town, and My Son Sanctuary.
Timeline.event_2007_desc: By Prime Ministerial Decision, the Institute became the national leading research agency in heritage conservation.
Timeline.event_2018_desc: Launched the 'Digital Database of Ancient Architecture', applying 3D Laser Scanning technology.
Timeline.event_now_desc: With countless National and Special National Heritage restoration projects, the Institute continues to uphold the torch of knowledge.
